verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a reschedule endpoint covering accepted and pending bookings, and emits BOOKING_RESCHEDULED and BOOKING_CANCELLED events that webhooks and Zapier can act on. Calendar integrations such as Google and Apple Calendar are listed, but nothing shows they update automatically when a booking is rescheduled or cancelled. The evidence is API-centric and does not show the invitee-facing self-serve flow the story asks for. Missing for 10: invitee self-serve reschedule/cancel links from the confirmation, enforced policies (e.g. notice windows or cancellation limits), automatic updates to connected calendars on reschedule/cancel, and independent hands-on corroboration.
